policy: Twenty-one alternating pairs per cold/warm state, one benchmark child at a time, original 12 MP RGB8 input and distance 1. Core boundaries only are comparable. No quality equivalence claim from equal distance.

measurement.scope: Forward RGB8 core with borrowed input, DCT8, local CFL, adaptive quantization and explicit effort/pass selection. Public encoder input staging and pipeline conversion are separate; no quality promotion.

measurement.note: Single-thread native encoder core. Warm measurement skips first repetition. Process duration and memory include one decode; neither is encoder-only.
